title: Fix frontend build and restore Live camera capture/recording

requirements.summary: Resolve missing camera hook import so the frontend compiles and the Live "Camera Recording" tab renders.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/live/CameraCaptureRecorderCard.tsx` no longer imports a non-existent module path.
Frontend builds successfully with no TypeScript module-resolution errors related to `@/camera/useCamera`.
Navigating to the Live page and switching to the "Camera Recording" tab renders without a blank screen or runtime crash.

file_operations.description: Add a `useCamera` hook module at the path expected by `@/camera/useCamera` to eliminate the missing-import build failure. Implement it to be API-compatible with the selected "camera" component hook contract (capability: web-camera preview + control). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement camera start/stop behavior and friendly camera errors in `useCamera` for the Live recording UI.
acceptanceCriteria: On a supported browser, clicking "Enable Camera" shows a live preview in the `<video>` element.
If permission is denied, the UI shows the existing English message: "Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access to continue."
If no camera is available, the UI shows the existing English message: "No camera found. Please connect a camera device."
Clicking "Stop Camera" stops all MediaStream tracks and the preview stops.

file_operations.description: Implement `startCamera`/`stopCamera` using `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`, attach the acquired MediaStream to `videoRef.current.srcObject`, and manage `isActive`/`isLoading` state. Surface structured errors (`permission`, `not-found`, `not-supported`, etc.) so the existing Live UI maps them to the required English messages. Ensure stop logic stops all stream tracks and clears `srcObject`. Use the selected "camera" component contract as the reference for types/shape (capability: camera preview + control). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align the camera recording UI with the implemented `useCamera` behavior: ensure the preview always has non-zero dimensions, buttons are disabled while camera is initializing/stopping, and error rendering continues to show the required English permission/not-found messages based on `cameraError.type`.

requirements.summary: Fix browser TypeScript DOM typing issues in `useMediaRecorder` so it type-checks cleanly and recording remains functional.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/hooks/useMediaRecorder.ts` type-checks without relying on `NodeJS` timer types.
Frontend builds successfully with strict TypeScript settings used by the project.
Recording start/stop still works and produces a playable `recordedUrl` in the camera recording UI.

file_operations.description: Replace `NodeJS.Timeout` usage with browser-safe timer typing (e.g., `ReturnType<typeof setInterval>` or `number`) and adjust any interval/clearInterval calls accordingly. Keep recording lifecycle intact so start/stop still produces a playable `recordedUrl` in the Live camera recording UI.
